Estimated intake, assuming everything was eaten except a little juice left in the fruit bowl:

- **Sushi:** about 7 pieces of maki/futomaki (roughly 30 g each, 210 g total), about 300 kcal. Pickled ginger, about 15 g, about 5 kcal. A little wasabi, negligible.
- **Fruit salad:** about 250 g, about 130 kcal.
- **Toast:** 2 half slices of whole wheat, essentially one slice, about 40 g, about 110 kcal. It may have been buttered, so I put it at about 130 kcal.
- **Coffee:** about 150 g, about 2 kcal.
- **Water:** about 250 g, 0 kcal.

Food mass excluding water and coffee comes to about 515 g. Including coffee it is about 665 g; including water as well it would be about 915 g. I report the mass with coffee and without water.

Total energy is about 570 kcal.
